The war between the Polisario Front and Morocco and Mauritania for Western Sahara, from 1975 to a UN ceasefire in 1991.

Polisario raids hit Mauritania hardest: they struck its iron-ore railway and even shelled Nouakchott, and after a coup Mauritania made peace and gave up its claim in 1979. Morocco took that part too and fought on, building the sand wall in the 1980s to keep the guerrillas out. Tens of thousands of Sahrawis fled to camps in Algeria. The 1991 ceasefire, watched by MINURSO, promised a referendum that has never been held. Fighting resumed at a low level in 2020.
sum: The war between the Polisario Front and Morocco and Mauritania for Western Sahara, from 1975 to a UN ceasefire in 1991.
